description: Normative execution profile for decoder bundles (CN-44, revision 17). The envelope's decoderLineage entries name this profile by its closed enum value; the profile document itself is content-addressed at the RELEASE layer (its sha256 is pinned in the vector manifest and re-checked on every suite run), so its meaning cannot drift between implementations without a new profile name or an envelopeVersion bump.
environmentDigestForm: a LEAF single-platform OCI image-manifest digest (sha256:<64 lowercase hex>), never a multi-architecture index digest and never a mutable tag

requirements.input: only through the declared inputFormat channel (raw committed transaction bytes on stdin)
requirements.output: only through the declared output channel (canonical decode dispositions on stdout)

runtimeVerifierDuties: the retrieved image's manifest digest equals the envelope's environmentDigest
the bundle's canonical manifest repeats environmentDigest, platformProtocolVersion, entryPoint, and inputFormat, each equal to the serialized lineage entry
execution under this profile is observably conformant: network blocked, filesystem read-only, declared channels only, undeclared environment inputs rejected
